title: 第一卷 第16章 诡异信件第一卷 第17章 红衣弟子
slug: 百倍返还我家孽徒全是女帝转世
content_zh:
林枫又将一旁剩余的一批灵铁、兽骨与炼材推了过去：“另外我还想再打造几件法宝，品阶最低也要达到地阶上品，您开个价吧。”
老者逐一清点材料，沉吟片刻。
他对着林枫伸出两根手指：“道友，材料是你自备的，我只算人工与炉火损耗，一共两百枚上品灵石。”
林枫抬手从储物袋中分出两百枚上品灵石，递了过去：“价钱没问题，便有劳前辈费心了。不知多久可以取货？”
老者接过灵石收好，脸上露出笑意：“材料虽好，但工序繁杂。
单这一把剑重新锻造，需要半个月，其他的全部打造完，一共需要两个月。”
“好。”林枫应下，又叮嘱了几句细节，便不再多留。
清霜剑稳稳落于小竹峰大殿。
柳雨姝正端坐竹林下的蒲团上潜心修炼，周身太阴灵气萦绕。
这半个月来，她日夜苦修，修为已到达炼气三层，正朝着炼气四层迈进。
察觉到熟悉的师父的气息，柳雨姝眉眼弯弯，迈着欢喜的步伐迎上：“师父，您回来了。”
话音未落，少女灵动的眸光微微一顿，师父身上的气息似乎变了。
随后她眼底炸开一抹强烈的震惊，小嘴微微张起，心头掀起滔天巨浪。
金丹！
师父突破金丹境了！
她清清楚楚记得，师尊闭关出山时不过筑基八层，短短半月，竟直接突破到了金丹境！
震惊之余，她心底涌起浓浓的紧迫感，垂落的小手悄然攥紧。
在心底默默立誓：往后定要加倍苦修，早日追上师尊的脚步！
林枫看出柳雨姝在想什么，抬手轻轻揉了揉柳雨姝的头。
“不必心急。”林枫声音慵懒温和，缓缓开口，“你根基尚浅，夯实道基，便是最好的修行。

柳雨姝仰头望着眼前白衣绝尘的师尊，轻轻点头：“弟子谨记师尊教诲，绝不急躁冒进。”
这是林峰的脑海里突然响起系统提示音。
“叮！检测到宿主成为弟子柳雨姝心目中的榜样，触发隐藏奖励一份。”
“恭喜宿主获得天品聚灵丹【表情】2、资质上升2点。（注：天品聚灵丹内含1万灵气。）”
“请宿主再接再厉。”
林峰有些惊诧，原来成为弟子的榜样也能触发奖励吗？
他回过神，将剩下的一些灵材都给了柳雨姝。
“多谢师尊！”柳雨姝双手拿着沉甸甸的储物袋，眼眶微热。
师徒二人又闲聊片刻，林枫便转身前往峰顶闭关。
他没有使用天品聚灵丹，决定等灵根完全恢复之后再使用，这样风险更小。
夕阳西落，暮色渐沉。
柳雨姝结束了一天的苦修，进入厢房正想洗漱歇息。转身之际，目光忽然瞥见木桌正中央，静静躺着一封信件。
她满脸诧异，自己今日一整天都在峰上，从未有人靠近，这信件究竟是何时出现的？
带着满心疑虑，柳雨姝快步上前，打开了信件。
信封没有落款，打开信封，里面只有一张信纸。
字迹凌厉潦草，透着一股阴森诡异。
【欲知苏家灭门真相，今夜子时，后山寒潭，孤身前来。】
轰！
content_en:
Lin Feng pushed the remaining batch of spiritual iron, animal bones and refined materials aside: "In addition, I also want to create a few more magic weapons. The lowest grade must reach the top grade of the earth. Please give me a price."
The old man counted the materials one by one and pondered for a moment.
He stretched out two fingers towards Lin Feng: "Fellow Taoist, you brought the materials yourself. I only count the labor and fire losses, and there are a total of two hundred high-grade spiritual stones."
Lin Feng raised his hand and took out two hundred high-grade spiritual stones from the storage bag and handed them over: "The price is okay, I'll spare you the trouble, senior. I wonder how long it will take to pick up the goods?"
The old man took the spirit stone and put it away with a smile on his face: "Although the materials are good, the process is complicated.
It would take half a month to reforge this sword alone, and a total of two months to complete the rest. "
"Okay." Lin Feng agreed and gave a few more details before leaving any more details.
The Qingshuang Sword landed steadily in the Xiaozhufeng Hall.
Liu Yushu was sitting on a futon under the bamboo forest, concentrating on practicing, with the Taiyin aura lingering around her.
Over the past half month, she has been practicing hard day and night, and her cultivation has reached the third level of Qi refining and is moving towards the fourth level of Qi refining.
Sensing the familiar Master's aura, Liu Yushu's eyebrows curved and she greeted him with joyful steps: "Master, you are back."
Before she finished speaking, the girl's smart eyes paused for a moment, and the master's aura seemed to have changed.
Then a strong shock burst out in her eyes, her mouth opened slightly, and a huge wave surged in her heart.
Golden elixir!
Master has broken through to the golden elixir realm!
She clearly remembered that when her master came out of seclusion and came out of the mountain, he only built the eighth level of the foundation. In just half a month, he actually broke through to the golden elixir realm!
After being shocked, a strong sense of urgency surged in her heart, and her hanging little hands clenched quietly.
I silently vowed in my heart: I will practice harder in the future and catch up with Master as soon as possible!
Lin Feng saw what Liu Yushu was thinking and raised his hand to gently rub Liu Yushu's head.
"Don't be impatient." Lin Feng spoke slowly and slowly in a lazy and gentle voice, "Your foundation is still shallow, and consolidating your Dao foundation is the best way to practice.
Liu Yushu raised her head and looked at the master in white clothes in front of her, and nodded gently: "Disciple, please remember the master's teachings and never rush into anything hastily. "
This was when the system prompt suddenly sounded in Lin Feng's mind.
“Ding! It is detected that the host becomes a role model in the mind of disciple Liu Yushu, triggering a hidden reward. "
"Congratulations to the host for obtaining the Heavenly Grade Spirit Gathering Pill [Expression] 2, and the qualifications have increased by 2 points. (Note: The Tianpin Spirit Gathering Pill contains 10,000 spiritual energy.)"
“Host, please keep up the good work. "
Lin Feng was a little surprised. Can becoming a role model for disciples also trigger rewards?
He came to his senses and gave some of the remaining spiritual materials to Liu Yushu.
"Thank you Master! "Liu Yushu held the heavy storage bag in both hands, her eyes slightly hot.
The master and apprentice chatted for a while, and then Lin Feng turned around and went to the summit for retreat.
He did not use the Tianpin Spirit Gathering Pill and decided to wait until his spiritual roots were fully recovered before using it, which would be less risky.
The sun sets in the west and twilight becomes darker.
Liu Yushu finished her hard work for the day and entered the wing to wash up and rest. When he turned around, his eyes suddenly caught a glimpse of a letter lying quietly in the center of the wooden table.
She was full of surprise. She had been on the peak all day today and no one had ever approached her. When did this letter appear?
Full of doubts, Liu Yushu stepped forward quickly and opened the letter.
The envelope was unsigned. When I opened the envelope, there was only a piece of letter paper inside.
The handwriting was sharp and sloppy, giving off an eerie feeling.
[If you want to know the truth about the Su family’s destruction, I came alone in the cold pool in the back mountain at midnight tonight. 】
Boom!
